options.name: Acid Bomb
options.benefit: Bombs deal acid damage and continue dealing 1d6 acid damage on the following round.

options.name: Combine Extracts
options.benefit: Combine two extracts into one preparation using a slot two levels above the higher formula.

options.name: Concentrate Poison
options.benefit: Combine two doses of the same poison to increase its save DC and duration.

options.name: Concussive Bomb
options.benefit: Bombs deal sonic damage and can deafen their targets.

options.name: Delayed Bomb
options.benefit: Place a bomb that explodes after a chosen delay.

options.name: Dilution
options.benefit: Dilute a potion or elixir once per day to create additional doses.

options.name: Dispelling Bomb
options.benefit: A bomb can act as a targeted dispel magic on a creature it strikes.

options.name: Enhance Potion
options.benefit: Use Alchemist level as the caster level of a consumed potion.

options.name: Eternal Potion
options.benefit: Make one eligible potion's effect permanent on yourself.

options.name: Explosive Bomb
options.benefit: Increase bomb splash radius and splash damage.

options.name: Extend Potion
options.benefit: Potions with sufficient duration last twice as long when consumed.

options.name: Fast Bombs
options.benefit: Throw multiple bombs during a full attack.

options.name: Feral Mutagen
options.benefit: Gain two claw attacks and a bite attack while using a mutagen.

options.name: Force Bomb
options.benefit: Bombs deal force damage and can knock creatures prone.

options.name: Frost Bomb
options.benefit: Bombs deal cold damage and can stagger their targets.

options.name: Greater Mutagen
options.benefit: Mutagens improve two physical abilities and grant greater natural armour.

options.name: Infuse Mutagen
options.benefit: Create a persistent mutagen usable by another creature.

options.name: Infusion
options.benefit: Extracts persist outside your possession and can be used by other creatures.

options.name: Madness Bomb
options.benefit: Bombs damage Wisdom and can confuse their targets.

options.name: Poison Bomb
options.benefit: Create a cloud duplicating cloudkill instead of normal bomb damage.

options.name: Precise Bombs
options.benefit: Exclude a limited number of squares from bomb splash damage.

options.name: Preserve Organs
options.benefit: Gain a stacking chance to negate critical-hit and sneak-attack damage.

options.name: Shock Bomb
options.benefit: Bombs deal electricity damage and can dazzle their targets.

options.name: Smoke Bomb
options.benefit: Create an obscuring cloud instead of normal bomb damage.

options.name: Sticky Bomb
options.benefit: Direct bomb targets take additional damage on the following round.

options.name: Sticky Poison
options.benefit: Applied poison remains effective for multiple weapon strikes.

options.name: Stink Bomb
options.benefit: Smoke bombs duplicate stinking cloud rather than fog.

options.name: Wings
options.benefit: Grow functional wings for a number of minutes per day equal to Alchemist level.
